centralFacts.evidence: Independently recomputed in Python from P x r / (1 - (1+r)^-n): $15,000/7%/48/12 gives payment $359.19, finance charge $2,241.30, Rule of 78 earned $971.99 (43.37%), actuarial $943.34 (42.09%), difference $28.65, refunds $1,269.31 and $1,297.96.
